title: Passive Voice: More Requests and Orders — Quiz 106
content:
## Passive Voice: More Requests and Orders

Change the following instructions into passive voice.

### Lesson focus

1. Follow the govt guidelines to beat Covid 19.
2. Tell people to stay indoors.
3. Sit down, please.
4. Shut up.

### Practise with the image

Read the full lesson image for the original exercise, notes and any answer key shown. Write your own answers before checking a key. A key labelled for another quiz belongs to that quiz.
